periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 15-20 degrees relative to the vertical facial midline, with the inferior poles angled toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovoid, with a height-to-width ratio significantly greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable tapering at the inferior margin, creating a teardrop effect where the mass is concentrated in the upper two-thirds.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the ears positioned at the 10 o'clock and 2 o'clock positions on the cranial perimeter.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High degree of convexity; the apex follows a smooth, semicircular arc without flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Heavy brownish-yellow discoloration and soiling of the ventral/abdominal pelage, contrasting sharply with the white cranial fur.
